subject.title: Bug: License incorrectly displayed as MIT-0 instead of MIT

question: Should ClawHub continue relicensing every published skill as MIT-0, or preserve a publisher's detected standard MIT declaration across storage and display?
rationale: Current documentation makes MIT-0 an intentional platform contract, so changing it affects publisher consent and persisted metadata rather than only correcting presentation text.

options.title: Honor declared MIT safely
options.body: Approve standard MIT support with explicit publication consent, conservative metadata detection, compatibility tests, and a narrowly scoped existing-version backfill.

options.title: Retain fixed MIT-0
options.body: Keep the current platform license contract and clarify during publishing that package-level license metadata does not control the ClawHub listing.

options.title: Pause for legal review
options.body: Hold the linked PR until the foundation confirms whether upload consent permits overriding or preserving package-level licenses.

recommendation.title: Honor declared MIT safely
recommendation.body: Approve standard MIT support with explicit publication consent, conservative metadata detection, compatibility tests, and a narrowly scoped existing-version backfill.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available routing candidate connected to the historical license-policy discussion and permanent platform contract.
